rabbitmq_otel-consumer-availability-99.5.reason: Upstream template defect: the SLI counts every rabbitmqreceiver queue document as an occurrence and calls it good only if rabbitmq.consumer.count >= 1, but the receiver writes rabbitmq.message.current per state (ready, unacknowledged) as separate documents without the consumer gauge, so real data also scores about 33%. Fixing it in the generator would triple the dashboards' consumer sums.
